# Layout decisions: WS-02 packet validation and normalization

Companion to `docs/build/ws-02-packet-validation.md`. Every `[default chosen]` in that brief is a row below, with the alternative and who reconciles it. Siblings: `internal/build/layout-decisions-contracts.md` (WS-00), `layout-decisions-geometry.md` (WS-04–06), `layout-decisions-criteria.md` (WS-09). Numbers marked "measured" come from running `packetgen.validate` and pillow-heif on the store fixtures `yt-0gotY_syWWU` and `yt-12Ks1idWj40` (2026-09-26).

## 1. Defaults chosen

| # | Brief § | Decision | Why this default | Alternative / reconcile with |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0, 3 | New run artifact `capture_check.json` (`CaptureCheck`) next to WS-00's `validation.json` and `normalized.json` | WS-00 §3.9 has no home for the checklist; the event payload `CaptureCheckData {complete, missing}` is too small for reviewer detail | add the row to WS-00 §3.9; owner WS-00 |
| 2 | 0, 3, 12 | Transcoded HEIC stills at `captures/{captureId}/normalized/stills/<id>.jpg` (capture prefix, not `runs/{runId}/`) | one prefix to materialize for every later stage; idempotent across re-runs | `runs/{runId}/normalized/...`; WS-00 storage-key table, WS-03 materialization |
| 3 | 3 | `run(ctx)` reads `ctx.inputs["packet_dir"]`, else materializes `captures/{capture_id}/**` via `Storage.list_prefix` + `get_bytes` into `ctx.work_dir/packet` | keeps WS-02 runnable in a fresh container without WS-03 conventions | WS-03 decides the canonical `inputs` key |
| 4 | 3, 12 | `validation.json` is WS-02's structured `ValidationReport` (`errors[]` = `{code, level, pointer, message}`), not WS-00's `PacketReport` with `list[str]` | the 422 body (`ApiError`) needs pointers; string lists cannot carry them | WS-00 owner adopts `ValidationReport` or adds pointers to `PacketReport` |
| 5 | 3 | `NormalizedPacket(Packet)`: derived data serialized under `ext.hss` (packet), `keyframes[i].ext.hss`, `stills[i].ext.hss`, `taps[i].ext.hss` | the normalized file stays a valid v0.4 packet (`server.contracts.cli check` accepts it); one reader for raw and normalized; the spec reserves `ext` for exactly this | separate wrapper `{packet, derived}` (breaks WS-04's field reads) |
| 6 | 3 | Field names camelCase = wire names, incl. derived fields (`primaryEpoch`, `pathLengthM`) | WS-00 §3.1 rule for everything that round-trips through packet JSON | snake_case internal models |
| 7 | 4.1 | `formatVersion` must equal `"0.4"` (`format_version_unsupported`) | v0.3 ARKit packets fail v0.4 rules anyway; field names may change before 1.0, so each minor needs a validator update | accept `^0\.[0-9]+$` and rely on schema failures |
| 8 | 4.1 | `source.kind == synthetic` → warning in dev, error `synthetic_in_prod` when `SMP_ENVIRONMENT == prod` | fixtures are synthetic and must validate; production must never treat synthetic data as evidence | reject everywhere except tests |
| 9 | 4.1 | Thresholds in a frozen `PacketParams` dataclass, no env overrides | WS-00's `Settings` is for platform config; validation thresholds change through PRs and tests | `PACKET_*` env knobs (WS-04 used `HSS_POSES_*`) |
| 10 | 4.3 | Rotation: error at `1e-3` (housepipe), warning `pose_rotation_drift` at `1e-4` (packetgen), SVD re-orthonormalization in the normalized pose | real devices serialize rotations rounded to 4–6 decimals (spec example: 6e-5); fixtures measure 1.3e-6 | single 1e-4 error (rejects the spec's own example if rounded harder) |
| 11 | 4.3 | `‖t‖ > 1000 m` → `pose_translation_absurd`; `worldAlignment: gravityAndHeading` → warning, `camera` → error | ARKit origin is the session start; a house walk stays < 200 m; `gravityAndHeading` is still y-up (spec §2 only discourages it) | reject `gravityAndHeading` too |
| 12 | 4.4 | FOV bands: error outside 20–150°, warning `fov_unusual` outside 45–100°; `focal_aspect` 2 %; `principal_point_offcentre` 5 % of w/h | iPhone wide ≈ 64–67° (`fx/w ≈ 0.75`, A6/A7, spec example 67.3°); fixtures from cropped YouTube video sit at 48° and must pass; profiles' principal-point σ is 2–4 px | tighter bands tuned on WS-13's real capture |
| 13 | 4.4 | High-res keyframe whose `fx/w` deviates > 20 % from the session median → intrinsics rescaled by `w / imageResolution[0]`, flag `intrinsics_rescaled` | spec §2 requires scaled intrinsics; an app that copies `ARCamera.intrinsics` onto a 4032 px frame would wreck WS-04's locked-intrinsics priors | error instead of auto-fix |
| 14 | 4.4 | `low_resolution` warning below 640 px long side | spec §5.1 table: 480p walks registered 135/141 | error below 1280 |
| 15 | 4.5 | Same-epoch keyframes with `|Δt| < 1e-3 s`: identical pose → `duplicate_keyframe` warning; centres > 1 cm apart → error `keyframe_timestamp_conflict`; array order out of time order → warning `keyframe_order` | spec §6 lists increasing timestamps as a check, both existing validators only warn; an app appending close-up frames after the walk is legitimate | make `keyframe_order` an error (would 422 valid packets) |
| 16 | 4.5 | `timestamp_before_epoch` at 0.5 s; primary epoch = most keyframes, ties → earliest `startTime` | generator's `e2.startTime = t_reset − 0.3 s`; housepipe picked the largest epoch | WS-04 re-anchors on the meter epoch |
| 17 | 4.6 | `pose_jump` > 3.0 m/s over Δt ≥ 0.1 s; `pose_spin` > 180°/s; `tracking_unstable` when > 5 % of pairs; `limited_tracking_share` > 0.30 | walking is ≤ 2 m/s (fixtures: median 0.7, max 0.9 m/s measured); ARKit's own `excessiveMotion` trips at 60–120°/s in the profiles | tune on WS-13's real capture |
| 18 | 4.7 | Gravity vs `motion` stream: warning at 3° median, error `gravity_conventions` at 15° with ≥ 100 matched rows; pitch flags `pitched_up` > +30°, `pitched_down` < −45° | fixtures measure 0.16° median; 15° means the device-from-camera axes or `worldAlignment` are wrong, which breaks every y-up assumption downstream | warning only |
| 19 | 4.8 | `depth` missing on a `highResolution: true` keyframe → warning `depth_missing_highres`, not the spec's error | `captureHighResolutionFrame` frames may carry no `sceneDepth`; spec example k00003 has `depth: null` | spec PR (WS-14) either way |
| 20 | 4.8 | Depth value sanity on every 10th depth frame: finite share ≥ 0.5, median 0.2–10 m, some confidence ≥ 1 | from `packetgen/checks.py` depth stats; LiDAR reach is 0.2–5 m | none |
| 21 | 4.9 | `imagesUsable` = ≥ 60 % of images decode and ≥ 10 (all when fewer than 10) | hosted-architecture failure table: 422 "if images are usable, route to manual review" needs a definition | WS-03 may override |
| 22 | 4.9 | HEIC → JPEG `quality=92`, EXIF kept, orientation applied (pillow-heif resets the tag to 1), `orientation = 1`, `compat` role in `files[]` | `photos.py` used q92 for imports; pillow-heif measured: Orientation-6 HEIC opens as 1440×1920 with Orientation 1, `original_orientation = 6`; role `compat` exists in the spec enum | q90 as keyframes; a new role (needs a spec PR) |
| 23 | 4.9 | HEIC allowed only for `photo_only` stills; anywhere else `image_format` error | spec Appendix D and hosted-architecture §2.1 say so explicitly | warning + transcode everywhere |
| 24 | 4.10 | Focal source order file EXIF → packet EXIF → 26 mm assumed (`intrinsicsAssumed`, `intrinsicsSource` stays `exif_focal35`); `focalRelBound` 0.02 read / 0.15 assumed; `non_wide_lens` outside 22–30 mm; `exif_focal_out_of_range` outside 10–200 mm | 26 mm is `packetgen/photos.py`'s default and the iPhone 13–16 main camera; Apple rounds `FocalLenIn35mmFilm` to an integer (≤ 2 % at 26 mm); WS-04 reads `exif_focal35` for both cases | separate `intrinsicsSource: assumed` (schema enum change) |
| 25 | 4.11 | `tap_hit_distance` warning outside 0.2–30 m | ARKit raycast hits closer than 0.2 m or beyond 30 m are not plausible for a house wall | none |
| 26 | 4.13 | `stream_empty` error; `stream_rate_low` below 0.5× declared; IMU units: median ‖a‖ in 9.0–10.6 → `scaleToG = 1/9.80665` + warning `imu_units_m_s2`; `arkit_pose_stream_gap` when no row within `2/rateHz` s and 0.05 m per keyframe | fixtures: ‖a‖ ≈ 1.0 g, `arkitPoses` hit every keyframe exactly (measured); a units slip (m/s²) is the likeliest real-app bug and is recoverable | reject m/s² streams |
| 27 | 4.14 | `branch = lidar` iff `lidarAvailable and sceneDepthEnabled` and ≥ 1 sized depth+confidence pair; depth files with `lidarAvailable == false` are ignored (`depth_without_lidar_flag`) | Hunter's LiDAR-first rule needs the device flag and real files to agree; housepipe used "any frame has depth" | trust files over the flag |
| 28 | 4.14 | `flow` from `CaptureRecord`, else inferred (`photo` for `photo_only`, `guided` otherwise) | packet has no `flow`; WS-00 §12 sets the same inference for the API | none |
| 29 | 4.15 | Frame flags `slow_exposure` > 1/60 s, `high_iso` ≥ 1600, `few_images` < 10 | spec §5.1 rule 4; A7 `noise_iso1600` breaks COLMAP registration on electro/facade | WS-03 QA may add blur scores |
| 30 | 4.16 | Checklist severities and thresholds: `meter_close`, `meter_oblique`, `meter_tap` (guided), `door_view_meter_side` (ARKit) required; panels recommended; `keyframe_count` 40, `keyframe_cadence` 0.6 m / 1.5 kf/s, `photo_count` 40, `tracking_quality` 0.30 as `weak` | spec §3.4/§5.2 name the required captures; counts follow the plan's 40–70 photo flow and 0.5 m cadence; A10 pending | re-tune on A10 and WS-13 |
| 31 | 4.16 | Event data stays WS-00's `CaptureCheckData {complete, missing}`; each missing/weak item also emits `HintData {code, message, retake}`; details in `capture_check.json` | fits the existing typed events without a contract change | extend `CaptureCheckData` with `unknown`, `mode` (WS-00 owner) |
| 32 | 4.17 | `merge_amendment` prefixes amendment ids with `<aid>/`, unions `files[]`, keeps the parent's `primaryEpoch` | ids like `k00001` collide across packets; paths already carry `amendments/<aid>/` | WS-04 registers into the parent model regardless |
| 33 | 5 | pillow-heif accepted (BSD-3 wheel bundling libheif, LGPL-3, dynamically linked) | only maintained Python HEIC decoder; A2/A6/A7 setups already install it | ImageMagick/`heif-convert` subprocess |
| 34 | 1, 7 | The four non-golden store tars are fetched by hand until a 4-entry additive PR to `data/fixtures/manifest.json` merges | the plan's gate says 33 packets; WS-00 fetches only the five golden houses (20 packets + 2 examples) | shrink the WS-02 gate to 22 (plan change) |

## 2. Inconsistencies found (not edited; for the coordinator and spec owners)

1. **Plan §6 WS-02 vs `packetgen/checks.py`.** The plan says to port `validate.py + checks.py` for the §6 checks; `checks.py` is the synthetic-house physics checker against `_truth/truth.json` (drift, compass, GPS), which pipeline code must never read. Only its IMU-gravity-vs-pose and depth-stat snippets are portable (brief §5).
2. **Plan header vs WS-00 layout.** Plan §0 names the repo layout `packet/ recon/ scene/ criteria/ eval/ data/ docs/ scripts/`; WS-00 builds `server/<stage>/` and leaves the snapshot dirs untouched. Briefs follow `server/`.
3. **Plan WS-02 gate "all 33 fixture packets" vs WS-00 §6 fixtures.** WS-00 fetches five houses (20 manifests + 2 examples); the plan's 33 needs `yt-0gotY_syWWU`, `yt-12Ks1idWj40`, `yt-4h8kyjnPo9s`, `yt-5-M-7f35Tyg` as well (decision 34).
4. **WS-00 `PacketReport` (`errors: list[str]`) vs the 422 body.** hosted-architecture §2.2 and WS-00's own `ApiError` need `{code, pointer, message}`; a string list cannot feed them (decision 4). WS-00 also pulled the geometry-free half of spec §6 into `check_packet`, so §6 is now split across two modules; the brief keeps WS-02 as the superset and adds an agreement test.
5. **Spec §3.2 `depth` "R when `sceneDepthEnabled`" vs high-resolution frames.** `captureHighResolutionFrame` output need not carry `sceneDepth`; the spec's own example has `depth: null` on the high-res k00003 (in tier `arkit`, so not a schema violation there). `packetgen/validate.py` errors on any missing depth (decision 19).
6. **Spec §6 "timestamps increase within an epoch" vs both validators.** `packetgen/validate.py` and `housepipe/validate.py` only warn (decision 15).
7. **Orthonormality tolerance.** `packetgen/validate.py` 1e-4 vs `housepipe/validate.py` 1e-3; the spec gives none (decision 10).
8. **Spec schema description typo.** `$defs.scaleReference.ext.obliqueCloseUp.still` says "Id of that still (purpose meter_close)"; §3.4, §6 and `validate.py` expect `meter_oblique`. Cosmetic, but a literal builder would copy it.
9. **hosted-architecture §2.2 file example uses `role: keyframe_image`.** Spec and WS-00 say `keyframe` (already noted in plan §4; WS-00 §4.5 rejects the alias).
10. **hosted-architecture §2.2 "Retake (amendment)" says the spec owner "may later add `parentPacketId`".** Spec v0.4 already has it (top-level, required on amendments). Stale sentence.
11. **hosted-architecture `capture_check` example emits `door_view_meter_side` during upload**, but `scaleReference.ext.doorViews` only travels in `packet.json` at finalize, and the per-file `meta` carries keyframe/still records only. Either the checklist item is `unknown` until finalize (brief default) or WS-14 lets `scaleReference` ride in a `meta` / a small `POST .../checklist` call.
12. **hosted-architecture failure table: "Packet invalid → 422".** Depth-size, sha256 and stream checks need the files, which may commit after finalize returned 202 (`awaiting_files`); those failures can only surface as a `failed` event / `manual_review`, not a 422. The brief splits `stage: manifest` (synchronous 422) from `stage: full` (event).
13. **hosted-architecture §2.1 records HEIC transcodes in `provenance.notes`.** `provenance` is a scene v0 field (WS-06 output); WS-02 carries the note in `derived.notes` for WS-06 to copy.
14. **`POST /captures` has `flow: guided|photo`; the packet has no `flow` field.** WS-02 receives it from `CaptureRecord` or infers it (decision 28).
15. **Fixture layout vs spec layout.** Archives store streams under `streams/<variant>/<name>.csv.gz` and features under `features/<variant>/`; the spec says `streams/<name>.csv.gz` and `keyframes/k00001.features.bin`. `index.json` claims the variant layout is "per the Upload API", which the spec does not say. Harmless when every path is resolved through `files[]`.
16. **Plan §6 WS-02 "gravity from ARKit or IMU".** For ARKit tiers gravity is world −y by construction; for `photo_only` it is `stills[].gravity` from `CMDeviceMotion` (device frame). The `imuRaw` stream is not a gravity source (raw accelerometer includes user acceleration); the brief uses `motion.grav*` only as a consistency check.
17. **`housepipe/validate.py` docstring** says the stored benchmark packets are format 0.1; the archives are v0.4 (rebuilt 2026-09-26). WS-00 vendors it as `validate_legacy.py`; it must not be treated as the v0.4 reference.
18. **WS-04 brief §3 reads `packet_id` from `NormalizedPacket`**; the wire name (and WS-00 §3.1 rule) is `packetId`. WS-04's list otherwise matches the brief's `NormalizedPacket` fields.
19. **WS-04 brief expects `intrinsicsSource: exif_focal35` for the assumed-26 mm case**; the brief complies and adds `intrinsicsAssumed` so the cases stay distinguishable (decision 24).
20. **Spec Appendix A `$id`** points at `SamGu-NRX/house-scanning`; the server repo is `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`. Cosmetic; WS-00 keeps the `$id` verbatim.
21. **Duplicate geometry helpers.** `packetgen/conventions.py` and `housepipe/geometry.py` both define `from_column_major`, `pixel_ray_arkit`, `project_arkit`; WS-00 puts the housepipe set in `server/common/geometry.py`, so WS-02 ports only `DEVICE_FROM_CAMERA`, `world_from_device`, `CM_FROM_ARKIT_WORLD`, quaternion helpers.
22. **Reserved role `compat`.** The spec enum has `compat` with no definition; the brief uses it for server-derived transcodes. WS-14 should define it in the spec (or add `derived`).
23. **WS-03 brief vs WS-00 artifact names and WS-02 signature.** `docs/build/ws-03-orchestrator.md` names the `validate` stage outputs `normalized_packet.json` / `validation_report.json` and expects `normalize_packet(packet_json, root) -> (NormalizedPacket, ValidationReport)`, `NormalizedPacket.to_json()/from_json()`, and `validation_report.usable_images`. WS-00 §3.9 fixes the names `normalized.json` / `validation.json`; the WS-02 brief follows WS-00, adds `validate_and_normalize(...) -> tuple[NormalizedPacket, ValidationReport]`, `to_json`/`from_json`, and `imagesDecodable: int` next to `imagesUsable: bool`, so WS-03 needs only the file names changed.
24. **`internal/build/reconciliation-queue.md`** (coordinator-owned, no frontmatter) lists cross-cutting items; the WS-02 items above are not yet in it. The env-prefix question it raises does not affect WS-02 (no env knobs; `PacketParams` only).

## 3. Measurements behind the defaults

- `packetgen.validate.validate_packet` on `yt-0gotY_syWWU` (4 variants, 47 keyframes, 18 MB) and `yt-12Ks1idWj40` (6 stills): all `ok`, 0 warnings, 0.01–0.05 s each including sha256; tap replay error 3.3–5.3e-7; worst rotation orthonormality 1.3e-6; keyframe speed median 0.65–0.70 m/s, max 0.85–0.91 m/s; `motion` gravity vs pose 0.16–0.18° median, 1.49° max; `imuRaw` ‖a‖ median 0.98–1.03 g; `arkitPoses` rows 2527 at 30 Hz, every keyframe matched at Δt = 0, Δpos = 0; horizontal FOV 47.8–48.1° (source-video crop, `fx/w = 1.12`); pose-free stills `f35 = 39`, `photo-only` stills 1920×1080 with `f35 = 26 → fx = 1323.782`.
- Spec `example-packet.json`: tap replay 1.1e-5 (pose rounded to 4 decimals, orthonormality error 6.0e-5, det 0.99994), horizontal FOV 67.3°, `fx/w = 0.7511`; `check_scale_reference` clean.
- Pillow 12.3 decode of 47 × 1920×1440 JPEGs: 0.31 s (6.5 ms each); header-only sizes 1 ms; sha256 of 210 files / 18 MB: 0.01 s (warm cache).
- pillow-heif 1.8.0: `from_pillow(im).save(path, quality=50, exif=<Orientation 6>)` → 99 KB `ftypheic`; `register_heif_opener()` + `Image.open` → `HEIF (1440, 1920)`, `info["original_orientation"] == 6`, EXIF `Orientation == 1`; re-saved JPEG q92 keeps `Orientation 1`, 404 KB.
